products.name: Casino Gaming Services
products.description: Operation of full-service casinos offering slot machines, table games, and related gaming activities at physical properties in North America and Poland. Requires regulated infrastructure, licensed facilities, and in-person human labor.

products.name: Hotel and Resort Lodging
products.description: Provision of hotel accommodations and resort amenities at casino properties, including guest rooms, suites, and related hospitality services. Requires physical facilities and in-person staff.

products.name: Food and Beverage Services
products.description: Operation of restaurants, bars, lounges, and banquet facilities at casino and resort properties, providing dining and beverage options to guests. Requires physical venues and in-person service staff.

products.name: Sports Betting (Retail and Online)
products.description: Provision of sports wagering services through on-site sports books and online/mobile applications, often in partnership with third-party operators. Requires regulatory approval, technology platforms, and licensed operations.

products.name: iGaming (Online Casino Gaming)
products.description: Offering online casino gaming services, including slots and table games, through digital platforms in regulated jurisdictions. Requires technology infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Horse Racing and Pari-Mutuel Wagering
products.description: Operation of live horse racetracks and provision of pari-mutuel wagering, including off-track betting parlors and advance deposit wagering for online betting. Requires regulated racetrack facilities and wagering systems.

products.name: Event and Convention Services
products.description: Hosting of entertainment events, conventions, meetings, and concerts at dedicated venues within casino resorts, including showrooms, amphitheaters, and conference centers. Requires physical event spaces and event management staff.

products.name: Golf Course Operations
products.description: Operation of golf courses at select casino resort properties, providing recreational services to guests. Requires physical golf course facilities and maintenance staff.

products.name: Zero Sugar Soda
products.description: A line of zero sugar, zero calorie, naturally sweetened sodas available in 20 flavors, manufactured by third-party contract manufacturers and distributed in aluminum cans through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Zero Sugar Energy Drinks
products.description: A line of zero sugar energy drinks containing 120 mg of organic caffeine, offered in eight flavors, produced by third-party manufacturers and distributed primarily through natural and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Zero Calorie Ready-to-Drink Tea
products.description: A line of zero calorie, naturally sweetened ready-to-drink teas available in eight flavors, including one caffeine-free option, manufactured by third-party partners and distributed in aluminum cans; this product line will be discontinued in 2026.

products.name: Traditional Watches
products.description: Design, manufacture, and distribution of traditional (non-smart) watches under both owned and licensed brands. Products are physically manufactured, often with Swiss or precise movements, and sold globally through wholesale, retail, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Jewelry
products.description: Design, manufacture, and distribution of fashion jewelry under both owned and licensed brands. Products are physically manufactured and sold through similar channels as watches, including retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Handbags and Small Leather Goods
products.description: Design, manufacture, and distribution of handbags, wallets, and other small leather accessories, primarily under owned brands. Products are physically manufactured and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Belts
products.description: Design, manufacture, and distribution of fashion belts, primarily under owned brands. Products are physically manufactured and sold through the same channels as other accessories.

products.name: Eyewear (Sunglasses and Optical Frames)
products.description: Design and distribution of sunglasses and optical frames, primarily under the FOSSIL brand via a licensing agreement. Products are physically manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Private Label Accessories
products.description: Manufacture and/or distribution of accessories under private label brands for third parties. Products are physically manufactured and distributed to external customers.

products.name: MAR-T Cell Therapies
products.description: T cell-based immunotherapies manufactured by expanding natural tumor-specific T cells from patient or donor blood, designed to recognize and kill heterogeneous tumors by targeting multiple tumor-associated antigens without genetic modification. Delivered as either autologous (patient-derived) or off-the-shelf (donor-derived) cell products for the treatment of hematological malignancies and solid tumors.

products.name: Linaclotide-based Therapies (LINZESS/CONSTELLA)
products.description: Prescription pharmaceutical products containing linaclotide, marketed as LINZESS in the U.S., Mexico, Japan, and China, and as CONSTELLA in Canada and Europe, for the treatment of irritable bowel syndrome with constipation (IBS-C), chronic idiopathic constipation (CIC), and functional constipation (FC) in adults and pediatric patients. These are manufactured as oral capsules using peptide synthesis and distributed through pharmaceutical channels globally, often via strategic partnerships.

products.name: Apraglutide-based Therapies
products.description: A next-generation, synthetic long-acting peptide analog of GLP-2, developed for the treatment of short bowel syndrome with intestinal failure (SBS-IF) in patients dependent on parenteral support. The product is manufactured as a lyophilized powder for subcutaneous injection, with ongoing development for alternative presentations to improve patient convenience. Commercialization is planned in the U.S. and through partners internationally, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Kosmos Energy produces crude oil from deepwater offshore fields in Ghana, Equatorial Guinea, and the Gulf of America. Oil is extracted via subsea wells and FPSO platforms, then marketed and sold to external buyers through term and spot contracts.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Kosmos produces and sells natural gas, primarily as associated gas from oil fields in Ghana and as non-associated gas from the Greater Tortue Ahmeyim field in Mauritania and Senegal. Gas is transported via pipelines for processing and sale, including domestic supply agreements and export contracts.

products.name: Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Production and Sales
products.description: Kosmos participates in the production and sale of LNG from the Greater Tortue Ahmeyim field, using subsea systems, FPSO processing, and a floating LNG facility for liquefaction and export. LNG is sold under long-term contracts to global buyers.

products.name: Condensate and Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Kosmos produces and sells condensate and NGLs as byproducts of oil and gas extraction, particularly from gas fields in Mauritania, Senegal, and the Gulf of America. These liquids are separated during processing and sold to third-party purchasers.

products.name: Fresh Lemons
products.description: Production, harvesting, packing, and sale of fresh lemons grown on company-owned and third-party orchards, delivered to food service, wholesale, and retail customers. Requires large-scale farming, packinghouse operations, and distribution infrastructure.

products.name: Lemon Packing Services
products.description: Packing, grading, labeling, and preparing lemons (both company-grown and third-party) for marketing and distribution, including use of Sunkist trademarks. Involves physical packinghouse facilities and regulated processes.

products.name: Avocados
products.description: Production, harvesting, and sale of avocados, primarily Hass variety, grown on company orchards and sold to third-party packinghouses. Requires intensive farming and distribution to food service and retail markets.

products.name: Oranges and Specialty Citrus
products.description: Production and sale of oranges and specialty citrus varieties, grown on company orchards and marketed to customers. Involves traditional farming and distribution channels.

products.name: Wine Grapes
products.description: Cultivation and sale of wine grapes to wine producers, grown on company-owned vineyards. Involves agricultural production and bulk sales to processors.

products.name: Farm Management Services
products.description: Provision of farming, management, and operations services for third-party agricultural properties, including previously under management agreements. Requires agricultural expertise and in-person labor.

products.name: Residential and Commercial Property Rentals
products.description: Leasing of company-owned residential housing units and commercial office buildings to employees, former employees, and outside tenants. Involves property management and real estate operations.

products.name: Leased Land Operations
products.description: Leasing of agricultural land to third-party tenants for crop production, providing diversified income from land assets. Involves land management and tenant relationships.

products.name: Organic Waste Recycling and Composting
products.description: Operation and planned expansion of organic waste recycling and composting facilities, processing green and food waste into compost. Requires specialized facilities and environmental compliance.

products.name: Real Estate Development
products.description: Development of residential and commercial real estate projects, including master-planned communities, multi-family housing, and medical campuses. Involves land entitlement, construction, and joint ventures.

products.name: Water Rights Sales
products.description: Sale of water rights and pumping rights associated with company-owned land to external buyers. Involves legal transfer of water entitlements and related assets.

products.name: Billboard Advertising Services
products.description: Provision of advertising space on physical billboard structures, including both traditional static and digital billboards, primarily located on heavily traveled highways and roadways in major U.S. markets. This involves physical manufacturing, installation, and maintenance of billboard structures, as well as digital technology for dynamic content delivery.

products.name: Transit Advertising Services
products.description: Provision of advertising space on transit-related displays, including the interior and exterior of rail and subway cars, buses, benches, trams, trains, transit shelters, street kiosks, and transit platforms, operated under exclusive multi-year contracts with municipalities. Delivery requires negotiation and management of municipal contracts, installation and maintenance of displays, and integration of digital technology for dynamic content.

products.name: Digital Out-of-Home Advertising Solutions
products.description: Digital advertising solutions leveraging a network of digital billboards and transit displays, offering dynamic, visually engaging content, programmatic and direct sale advertising platforms, and advanced audience targeting and measurement. Delivered via proprietary and third-party digital infrastructure, requiring significant technology investment and integration with data and analytics platforms.

products.name: Advertising Campaign Services and Analytics
products.description: Value-added services for advertisers, including pre-campaign category research, consumer insights, print production, creative services, post-campaign tracking and analytics, and attribution solutions. These services are delivered through a combination of in-house expertise and technology platforms, supporting the planning, execution, and measurement of advertising campaigns.

products.name: Third-Party Digital Equipment Sales
products.description: Sale of digital advertising equipment to third parties, including marketing arrangements to sell advertising on third-party digital billboard displays. This involves the procurement and resale of digital display hardware and related technology.

products.name: Lithium-Ion Energy Storage Solutions for Material Handling Equipment
products.description: Modular, scalable lithium-ion battery packs designed, developed, manufactured, and sold for use in industrial lift trucks (forklifts) and related material handling equipment. These solutions are assembled in-house using sourced battery cells and proprietary battery management systems, and are delivered through OEMs, dealers, and direct sales.

products.name: Lithium-Ion Energy Storage Solutions for Airport Ground Support Equipment (GSE)
products.description: Lithium-ion battery packs specifically engineered for airport ground support equipment, including higher-voltage and higher-capacity systems for intensive airline and aviation applications. These are manufactured using modular designs and proprietary battery management systems, and sold through specialized GSE distributors and OEMs.

products.name: Smart Charging Solutions for Industrial Equipment
products.description: Onboard and wall-mounted smart chargers designed to interface with the company's battery management system, supporting both small and large lithium-ion battery packs for industrial and commercial applications. These chargers are sourced from third parties and integrated into the company's product ecosystem.

products.name: Battery Management and Telemetry Software (SkyBMS and SkyEMS)
products.description: Proprietary battery management system (BMS) and telemetry software solutions, including SkyBMS and SkyEMS, that provide real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, and fleet management for lithium-ion battery packs. These digital solutions are integrated with hardware products and offered as value-added features to customers.

products.name: Lithium-Ion Energy Storage Solutions for Other Industrial and Commercial Applications
products.description: Custom-configured lithium-ion battery packs and energy storage systems for a variety of industrial and commercial uses beyond forklifts and GSE, such as mobile energy storage systems, solar backup power for EV charging stations, and robotic warehouse equipment. These are based on the company's modular platform and delivered as tailored solutions.

products.name: Upholstered Furniture
products.description: Manufactured and imported upholstered furniture, including reclining chairs, sofas, and sectionals, produced in company-owned facilities in the US, Mexico, and UK, and delivered through retail stores, independent dealers, and online channels. Production involves physical manufacturing, customization, and regulated supply chain operations.

products.name: Casegoods (Wood) Furniture
products.description: Imported and distributed wood furniture products such as bedroom, dining room, and occasional furniture, sourced mainly from Asian suppliers and sold under various brand names through retail and wholesale channels. Delivery relies on global sourcing, inventory management, and distribution centers.

products.name: Home Furnishing Accessories
products.description: Retail and distribution of home furnishing accessories, including decorative items, sold alongside furniture products in stores and online. These are sourced and distributed through the same retail and wholesale networks as furniture.

products.name: Furniture Design Services
products.description: In-store and online design consultation services provided to consumers to assist in furnishing their homes, delivered by trained consultants as part of the retail experience in company-owned and branded stores.

products.name: E-commerce Furniture Sales
products.description: Direct-to-consumer sales of furniture and accessories through proprietary websites, offering online customization, ordering, and delivery, primarily under the La-Z-Boy and Joybird brands.

products.name: Fencing Products
products.description: Manufactured and distributed fencing solutions including steel frame gate kits, adjustable gate systems, steel posts, composite and cedar fencing, and portable security panels. Products are made using contract manufacturers, with both metal and wood components, and are sold through home centers, eCommerce, retailers, and direct to consumers.

products.name: Pet Products
products.description: Manufactured and distributed pet containment and comfort products such as kennels, kennel covers, crates, and exercise pens, primarily under the Lucky Dog® brand. Products are made with steel frames and other durable materials, sourced from contract manufacturers, and sold through retail and eCommerce channels.

products.name: Sustainable Bag Products
products.description: Compostable and post-consumer recycled (PCR) bags for food waste, yard waste, and pet waste, sold under the MyEcoWorld® brand. Products are manufactured using plant-based or recycled materials and are distributed to retailers and consumers.

products.name: Industrial Wood Products
products.description: Wholesale distribution of specialty wood products, including engineered noise and vibration reduction panels (dB-Ply®), structural panels, and jumbo concrete forms for transportation and industrial applications. Products are sourced from contract manufacturers and shipped from non-owned warehouses on a just-in-time basis.

products.name: Seed Processing and Sales (Discontinued)
products.description: Previously processed and distributed agricultural seed to distributors and provided seed cleaning services. Operations ceased in August 2023, with remaining inventory sold and facilities listed for sale.

products.name: Automotive Activated Carbon Products
products.description: Engineered and manufactured hardwood-based, chemically activated carbon in forms such as granules, pellets, and honeycomb scrubbers, primarily used in gasoline vapor emission control systems for internal combustion and hybrid vehicles. Also used in filtration for food, water, and chemicals. Produced in specialized plants using sawdust and phosphoric acid.

products.name: Pavement Technologies Additives
products.description: Manufactured additives and technologies for asphalt pavement construction, preservation, reconstruction, and recycling, including warm mix asphalt (Evotherm), emulsifiers, and specialty additives. Products are produced in U.S. plants from chemicals such as maleic anhydride and ethoxylates and delivered globally.

products.name: Road Markings Technologies
products.description: Manufactured thermoplastic and waterborne paint road marking products designed for long service life, adhesion, color, and retro-reflectivity, tailored to customer and regulatory requirements. Produced in U.S. facilities and sold primarily in North America.

products.name: Agrochemical Dispersants
products.description: Produced dispersants and inert ingredients for crop protection and agrochemical formulations, including both liquid and solid types. Manufactured from specialty chemicals in U.S. plants and sold globally to agrochemical companies.

products.name: Caprolactone-Based Specialty Polymers
products.description: Manufactured caprolactone and caprolactone-based specialty polymers for use in coatings, resins, elastomers, adhesives, bioplastics, and medical applications. Produced in a dedicated U.K. facility using cyclohexanone and hydrogen peroxide as raw materials.

products.name: Integrated Senior Health Campuses (ISHC)
products.description: Campuses providing a continuum of care for seniors, including independent living, assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing, and ancillary services, all within a single campus setting. Properties are physically owned or developed and operated via third-party management under a RIDEA structure.

products.name: Outpatient Medical Buildings (OM)
products.description: Multi-tenant commercial properties with specialized infrastructure for healthcare providers, including physician offices, examination rooms, pharmacies, diagnostic centers, rehabilitation clinics, and outpatient surgery. Properties are leased to third-party healthcare providers under long-term leases.

products.name: Senior Housing Operating Properties (SHOP)
products.description: Facilities catering to elderly populations, offering independent living, assisted living, memory care, and skilled nursing services. Properties are owned and operated under RIDEA structures, with services delivered by third-party operators and paid for primarily by residents or private insurance.

products.name: Triple-Net Leased Healthcare Properties
products.description: Senior housing, skilled nursing facilities, and hospitals leased to third-party tenants under triple-net or absolute-net leases, obligating tenants to pay all property-related expenses. Properties include SNFs, senior housing, and hospitals, often leased under master leases for risk mitigation.

products.name: Real Estate-Related Investments (Loans and Securities)
products.description: Origination and acquisition of secured loans, including first and second mortgage loans, mezzanine loans, bridge loans, and mortgage participations, secured by healthcare real estate. These are financial products rather than physical properties, provided on an infrequent and opportunistic basis.

products.name: Electric Utility Services (Florida)
products.description: Provision of regulated electric generation, transmission, distribution, and retail sale of electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Florida, primarily through owned generation facilities (natural gas, solar, nuclear, battery storage) and an integrated transmission and distribution network.

products.name: Wholesale Power Generation and Sales
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of large-scale generation facilities (wind, solar, nuclear, natural gas, battery storage) and sale of electricity, capacity, and related products to wholesale customers (utilities, cooperatives, commercial/industrial) across the U.S. and Canada, primarily under long-term contracts.

products.name: Battery Storage Solutions
products.description: Development, construction, ownership, and operation of battery storage facilities, both integrated with generation projects and as standalone assets, providing energy storage and firm capacity services to utilities and wholesale customers.

products.name: Regulated Electric Transmission Services
products.description: Ownership, development, construction, and operation of rate-regulated electric transmission assets and related infrastructure in North America, delivering electricity from generation sources to distribution systems and end users, with revenues determined by approved rates.

products.name: Regulated Natural Gas Transmission Services
products.description: Ownership interests in and operation of regulated natural gas pipelines, providing transportation services to utilities and other customers, primarily in the U.S., with revenues based on regulated rates and long-term contracts.

products.name: Energy Marketing and Trading Services
products.description: Provision of energy-related commodity marketing and trading services, including power and fuel commodities, risk management, and full energy and capacity requirements services to utilities, wholesale, and retail customers, as well as optimization and hedging of generation and fuel assets.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas and Biogas Products
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of renewable natural gas and biogas facilities, including landfill gas-to-electric and renewable fuels projects, supplying clean energy products to utilities and other customers.

products.name: JFrog Platform (Software Supply Chain Management Platform)
products.description: A unified, end-to-end platform that manages, secures, and automates the entire software supply chain, including package management, security, governance, and distribution, delivered as SaaS, self-managed, or hybrid deployments.

products.name: Universal Package and Artifact Management (JFrog Artifactory)
products.description: A core repository solution for storing, managing, and curating all types of software packages, binaries, containers, and AI/ML models, supporting all major package technologies and deployment environments.

products.name: Software Supply Chain Security Solutions (JFrog Xray, Advanced Security, Runtime Security)
products.description: A suite of integrated security tools providing vulnerability scanning, binary and contextual analysis, secrets detection, SAST, IaC scanning, container and runtime security, and compliance management for software packages and AI/ML models.

products.name: Software Package and AI/ML Model Curation (JFrog Curation, AI Catalog)
products.description: Solutions that control and govern the admission of open source and third-party software packages and AI/ML models into organizations, applying policies to block or allow based on risk, metadata, and compliance requirements.

products.name: Software Distribution and Delivery (JFrog Distribution)
products.description: A solution for reliable, scalable, and secure distribution of software packages and updates to multiple locations and endpoints, supporting enterprise-grade performance and integration with major package technologies.

products.name: IoT Device Management and Software Delivery (JFrog Connect)
products.description: A connected device management solution enabling companies to manage, update, and monitor software across fleets of IoT devices globally, automating secure package delivery from development to device.

products.name: Machine Learning and AI Operations (JFrog ML)
products.description: A platform-integrated solution for data science and AI/MLOps teams to build, train, secure, deploy, and monitor ML and AI models, including public, bespoke, and large language models, as part of the software supply chain.

products.name: Application Risk Governance (JFrog AppTrust)
products.description: A solution providing application risk governance, audit, and compliance management across the software supply chain, including cryptographically signed evidence and policy enforcement for software releases.

products.name: Specialty Property and Casualty Insurance
products.description: Underwriting and issuing specialty property and casualty insurance policies, including commercial and personal liability risks, through a group of admitted and E&S carriers. Policies are distributed primarily via program administrators and managing general agents, with risk retained and reinsured as appropriate. Requires regulated insurance infrastructure, underwriting expertise, and capital management.

products.name: Insurance Distribution Services (MGA/Us and Brokerage)
products.description: Distribution, underwriting, and administration of specialty property and casualty insurance products as a managing general agent/underwriter (MGA/U) and insurance broker. Services include delegated underwriting, policy structuring, and claims management for various specialty lines, earning commissions from insurance carriers. Delivered via a network of owned and partnered MGA/Us, brokers, and program administrators.

products.name: Accident & Health Insurance Products
products.description: Underwriting and distribution of accident and health insurance products, including employer stop loss, limited benefit medical, short-term medical, travel, and supplemental health and benefit solutions. Delivered through MGAs and brokers, often targeting niche markets and C-suite executives, with both insurance and related navigation/administration services.

products.name: Professional and Management Liability Insurance
products.description: Underwriting and distribution of professional liability and management liability insurance, including Directors & Officers (D&O), errors and omissions, and coverage for architects, engineers, construction managers, and real estate professionals. Delivered via MGAs and program administrators, requiring specialized underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial Auto Insurance
products.description: Underwriting and distribution of commercial auto insurance, including liability and physical damage coverage for for-hire auto classes such as school buses, charter buses, livery, and non-emergency medical vehicles. Delivered through MGAs with delegated underwriting authority and long-standing carrier relationships.

products.name: Marine & Energy Insurance
products.description: Underwriting and brokerage of marine and energy insurance products, covering risks such as ports, terminals, stevedores, and international exposures. Delivered through specialized MGAs and brokers with expertise in complex marine and energy risks.

products.name: Surety Insurance
products.description: Underwriting and distribution of surety insurance products, providing financial guarantees for performance and payment obligations. Delivered through MGAs and insurance carriers, requiring specialized underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Reinsurance Services
products.description: Assuming and ceding reinsurance for specialty property and casualty programs, both as a reinsurer and as a reinsurance intermediary. Involves risk transfer, capital management, and program diversification, delivered through regulated insurance carriers and intermediaries.

products.name: Environmental Insurance
products.description: Underwriting and distribution of environmental insurance products, covering environmental liabilities and risks for commercial clients. Delivered through MGAs and program administrators with specialized expertise.

products.name: Advanced Anode Materials (Silicon-rich, SiOx, and Biochar-derived)
products.description: Solidion develops and sells advanced anode materials, including silicon-rich, silicon oxide (SiOx), and biochar-derived graphite, produced using proprietary, scalable, and environmentally friendly processes. These materials are supplied to battery manufacturers for use in lithium-ion and next-generation batteries, targeting applications in EVs, energy storage, and consumer electronics.

products.name: Battery Cells (Cylindrical and Pouch Formats)
products.description: Solidion designs, develops, and manufactures advanced battery cells, including cylindrical and pouch cells, integrating its proprietary anode materials and electrolytes. These cells are produced through partnerships with toll manufacturers and are tailored for high energy density, power output, and safety for use in EVs, energy storage systems, drones, and consumer electronics.

products.name: Advanced Electrolytes (Fire-retardant, Quasi-solid, and Hybrid Solid Electrolytes)
products.description: Solidion develops and supplies advanced electrolyte formulations, including fire-retardant, quasi-solid, and hybrid solid electrolytes, designed for compatibility with existing lithium-ion battery manufacturing. These electrolytes enhance battery safety, energy density, and manufacturability, and are sold to battery manufacturers and partners.

products.name: Synthetic Allogeneic iMSC Cell Therapies for Cancer
products.description: Off-the-shelf, scalable cell therapies based on induced pluripotent stem cell-derived mesenchymal stem cells (iMSCs), engineered to secrete pro-inflammatory cytokines (e.g., IL-7, IL-15) for targeted anti-cancer immune responses. These therapies are manufactured using advanced cell engineering and contract manufacturing, and are delivered as biologic products for clinical use.

products.name: Synthetic Allogeneic iMSC Cell Therapies for Autoimmune Disorders
products.description: Cell therapies using iPSC-derived mesenchymal stem cells engineered to secrete anti-inflammatory cytokines (e.g., IL-10), designed to home to inflamed tissues and modulate immune responses in autoimmune diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis. These are produced via advanced cell engineering and delivered as off-the-shelf biologic products.

products.name: Homebuying Services Platform
products.description: An AI-powered digital platform (reAlpha platform) that integrates realty services, mortgage brokering, and digital title and escrow services to provide an end-to-end homebuying experience. Delivered primarily through web and iOS applications, it combines digital tools with licensed professionals for property search, tours, offers, financing, and closing.

products.name: Realty Services
products.description: Licensed real estate brokerage services assisting homebuyers with finding, touring, and closing on homes, delivered through digital interfaces and supported by real estate agents. Requires regulatory licensing and in-person professional support.

products.name: Mortgage Brokering Services
products.description: Mortgage brokering services that help homebuyers find and originate mortgages tailored to their financial situation, needs, credit, and location. Delivered digitally and supported by licensed loan officers, with plans to expand into direct mortgage lending.

products.name: Digital Title and Escrow Services
products.description: Digital title insurance, closing, and escrow services provided through licensed subsidiaries, facilitating secure and compliant real estate transactions. Delivered via digital platforms and requires regulatory compliance in each state.

products.name: AI-Powered Conversational Customer Experience Platform
products.description: A subscription-based AI-powered conversational platform (AiChat) for businesses, enabling automation and optimization of customer service, marketing, and e-commerce via major messaging channels. Delivered as SaaS, primarily in the APAC region, with features like chatbots, Voice AI, and integration with payment gateways.

products.name: Software Development and Technology Services
products.description: Custom software development, AI, and technology support services provided to third-party businesses, including development of AI-powered tools and ongoing technology support. Delivered by reAlpha Nepal as outsourced technology services.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of residential 1-4 family mortgage loans, including construction loans, primarily secured by properties in Montana. Loans are held in portfolio or sold in the secondary market with servicing often retained. Requires in-person underwriting, property appraisals, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate, including multi-family dwellings, office buildings, retail stores, warehouses, and commercial construction and development. Loans are tailored to borrower needs and secured by Montana properties. Requires in-person underwriting, property appraisals, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Provision of loans for farm and ranch real estate, agricultural production, and operating lines of credit, secured by real property, equipment, livestock, or crops. Delivered through in-person relationship banking in agricultural communities.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending
products.description: Origination of loans and lines of credit to businesses, secured or unsecured, including working capital, equipment, and inventory financing. Delivered through in-person relationship banking and tailored underwriting.

products.name: Home Equity Lending
products.description: Origination of home equity loans and lines of credit secured by borrowers’ primary residences, often subordinate to a first mortgage. Delivered through in-person and digital channels, with conservative underwriting.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans including auto loans, RV loans, boat loans, personal loans, credit lines, and loans secured by deposit accounts. Delivered through branch network and digital channels, with credit-based underwriting.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a variety of deposit accounts to individuals and businesses, including checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and IRAs. Delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking platforms.

products.name: Mortgage Loan Servicing
products.description: Servicing of mortgage loans sold to investors, including payment processing, escrow management, and foreclosure processing. Generates fee income and maintains customer relationships. Delivered through specialized servicing operations.

products.name: Digital Transformation and Cyber Security Services
products.description: Comprehensive digital modernization and cyber security solutions for federal agencies, including IT modernization, cloud enablement, cybersecurity, big data analytics, artificial intelligence, and risk management frameworks. Delivered primarily through prime contracts and leveraging advanced technology and certified personnel.

products.name: Science Research and Development Services
products.description: Large-scale scientific research and development services, including data analytics, clinical trials, epidemiology studies, and health informatics, primarily for federal health agencies. Delivered by specialized teams using evidence-based methods and advanced web technologies.

products.name: Systems Engineering and Integration Services
products.description: Engineering and integration services for federal agencies, including C5ISR, modeling and simulation, performance-based logistics, system modernization, and software engineering. Delivered by deploying specialized engineering teams and leveraging automation, cloud, and agile development processes.

products.name: Pharmacy and Logistics Services for VA CMOP Program
products.description: Pharmacy fulfillment and logistics services for the Department of Veterans Affairs' Consolidated Mail Outpatient Pharmacy (CMOP) program, involving the management and distribution of pharmaceuticals to veterans at multiple regional locations.

products.name: Monitoring, Evaluation, and Compliance Services for Head Start
products.description: Monitoring, evaluation, and compliance services for the Office of Head Start, involving assessment and oversight of Head Start programs to ensure regulatory compliance and program effectiveness. Delivered through specialized teams under federal contracts.

products.name: Nutritional Supplements
products.description: Science-based nutritional supplements, including core vitamins, minerals, and targeted optimizers, manufactured in-house and through third parties, distributed globally via direct selling, retail, and online channels.

products.name: Functional Foods and Meal Replacements
products.description: Meal replacement shakes, snack bars, protein bars, powdered protein drinks, and ready-to-drink protein beverages, produced in-house and by third parties, supporting weight management and healthy lifestyles, sold through omni-channel distribution.

products.name: Personal Care and Skincare Products
products.description: Premium science-based personal care and skincare products, including the Celavive skincare system, formulated with proprietary technology and manufactured in-house or by third parties, distributed globally.

products.name: Children’s Health and Wellness Products
products.description: Direct-to-consumer children’s health products, including chewable multivitamins, probiotics, greens & superfoods, bedtime essentials, iron, immune support, and hydration, primarily sold via subscription and retail channels under the Hiya brand.

products.name: Personal Development and Nutritional Programs
products.description: Personal development frameworks and nutritional products designed to help individuals achieve balance, growth, and purpose, delivered through direct selling and digital platforms (Oola).

products.name: Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Mortgage Loans
products.description: Origination and management of floating-rate first mortgage loans (whole loans) for commercial real estate properties, typically ranging from $10 million to $100 million, delivered through direct lending relationships and sometimes via participations or syndications. These loans are physically originated and require significant financial capital and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Preferred Equity Investments in Commercial Real Estate
products.description: Provision of preferred equity capital to entities owning or acquiring commercial real estate, subordinate to first mortgage loans and mezzanine debt, structured to provide credit enhancement. These investments are financial in nature and require capital allocation and underwriting.

products.name: Direct Equity Investments in Commercial Real Estate Properties
products.description: Acquisition and ownership of equity interests in commercial real estate properties, either directly, through joint ventures, or via properties acquired through foreclosure. These are physical assets requiring property management and capital investment.

products.name: Industrial Asset Auction and Liquidation Services
products.description: Provides global full-service auction, appraisal, and asset advisory services for surplus and distressed industrial assets, including turnkey manufacturing facilities and used industrial machinery and equipment. Delivered through a combination of in-person and online auctions, requiring physical asset handling and regulated auctioneer services.

products.name: Laboratory Equipment Refurbishment and Resale
products.description: Acquires, refurbishes, and resells specialized laboratory equipment, primarily serving the biotech and pharma sectors. Involves physical refurbishment and resale of tangible scientific instruments, often subject to export controls.

products.name: Charged-Off and Nonperforming Loan Brokerage
products.description: Brokers the sale of charged-off and nonperforming asset portfolios, including consumer and business loans, via an electronic auction exchange platform for banks and other debt holders. Delivered digitally with advisory and post-sale support services.

products.name: Specialty Lending for Asset Portfolio Investors
products.description: Provides specialty financing solutions, including secured loans, to investors in charged-off and nonperforming asset portfolios. Involves financial capital and risk management, with income from fees, interest, and profit sharing.

products.name: Wearable Infant Health Monitors (Dream Sock and BabySat)
products.description: Wearable, hospital-grade pulse oximetry monitors for infants, delivered as over-the-counter (Dream Sock) or prescription (BabySat) devices. These are manufactured physical products with embedded sensors and wireless connectivity, providing real-time health notifications and live readings to caregivers via a mobile app.

products.name: Smart Audio and Video Baby Monitors (Dream Sight)
products.description: Wi-Fi enabled audio and video monitoring devices for infants, featuring HD video, motion and cry detection, and two-way audio. These are physical hardware products manufactured and distributed globally, allowing parents to monitor their child remotely via a mobile app.

products.name: Integrated Health and Safety Monitoring Systems (Dream Duo)
products.description: A bundled system combining wearable biometric monitoring (Dream Sock) and smart video monitoring (Dream Sight) into a connected health and safety platform. Delivered as a physical product package with integrated software, providing comprehensive monitoring and analytics through the app.

products.name: Pediatric Health and Sleep Data Subscription Services (Owlet360)
products.description: A digital subscription service providing personalized health, sleep, and developmental insights for children, leveraging proprietary pediatric datasets and AI analytics. Delivered via the Owlet Dream App as a recurring, app-based service to caregivers.

products.name: Accessories for Monitoring Devices
products.description: Physical add-ons and enhancements for Owlet’s core monitoring products, such as fabric accessory socks and travel cases. These are manufactured goods sold to complement and extend the use of primary devices.

products.name: Oncology and Hematology Patient Services
products.description: Comprehensive outpatient medical care for oncology and hematology patients, including physician services, in-house infusion, radiation therapy, outpatient blood product transfusions, and 24/7 patient support, delivered through a network of clinics and providers. Services are provided under both fee-for-service and value-based contracts, utilizing physical clinics, medical professionals, and regulated healthcare infrastructure.

products.name: Specialty Pharmacy Services
products.description: Operation of specialty and retail pharmacies that fill oral, IV, and injectable medication orders incidental to oncology care, including medications for co-occurring conditions, billed through pharmacy benefit managers and delivered to patients for self-administration or administration inside or outside TOI clinics. Requires pharmacy operations, drug procurement, and compliance with pharmacy regulations.

products.name: Clinical Trials Management and Research Services
products.description: Management and provision of clinical trial services and research for cancer patients, including enrolling patients in clinical trials and conducting research in community clinic settings. Revenue is generated from pharmaceutical companies or contract research organizations for administering trials, requiring clinical research infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Palliative Care Services
products.description: Provision of palliative care programs for patients in the last stages of disease, integrated into oncology care and delivered in community clinic settings by specialized providers. Involves in-person clinical services and coordination with patients and families.

products.name: Assisted Tax Preparation Services
products.description: In-person or virtual tax preparation services provided by tax professionals at company-owned or franchise offices, including document drop-off and online review options. Requires human expertise and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: DIY Tax Preparation Solutions
products.description: Digital tax preparation solutions offered through online, mobile, and desktop software platforms, allowing clients to prepare and file their own tax returns with optional AI and human assistance. Delivered digitally via web and mobile applications.

products.name: Small Business Financial Solutions
products.description: Year-round financial services for small businesses, including tax preparation, bookkeeping, payroll, advisory, and payment processing, delivered both in-person and through online platforms such as Block Advisors and Wave. Combines human expertise with digital tools.

products.name: Refund Transfer Services
products.description: Banking services enabling clients to receive tax refunds via various disbursement methods and pay tax preparation fees directly from refunds, offered through partnerships with banks. Requires financial infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Prepaid Debit and Spending Accounts
products.description: Prepaid debit cards (Emerald Card®) and mobile banking app (SpruceSM) accounts for everyday purchases, ATM withdrawals, and direct deposit of tax refunds and other funds, issued through bank partners. Delivered via physical cards and digital platforms.

products.name: Refund Advance Loans
products.description: Short-term, interest-free loans offered to eligible clients in anticipation of tax refunds, provided through bank partners during tax season. Requires financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Emerald Advance Term Loans
products.description: Interest-bearing, short-term loans offered to clients in advance of tax season, with repayment due by March 31, provided through bank partners. Requires financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Tax Identity Protection Services
products.description: Tax Identity Shield® provides clients with monitoring, alerts, and restoration services to help protect and recover their tax identity, including dark web and credit header scans. Delivered digitally and with human support.

products.name: Audit Representation and Extended Service Plans
products.description: Peace of Mind® Extended Service Plan offers audit representation and coverage for additional taxes owed due to H&R Block errors, available to assisted tax preparation clients. Delivered by tax professionals and supported by insurance-like coverage.

products.name: Instant Refund Services (Canada)
products.description: Advances to Canadian clients in anticipation of tax refunds from the Canada Revenue Agency, with fees mandated by federal legislation. Requires financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: AI-Powered Matchmaking Technology Licensing
products.description: Licensing of proprietary AI-powered matchmaking technology, including advanced matching algorithms, safety features, engagement tools, and metaverse capabilities, to partners worldwide who use and customize the platform for local online dating and matchmaking services. The technology is developed through R&D and protected by patents, and is delivered as a customizable digital platform for B2B clients.

products.name: Social Networking Content Production and Agency Services
products.description: Production and sale of live-streamed and video content, including sports, gaming, and lifestyle broadcasts, to TikTok for users in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA region), under a Multi-Channel Network (MCN) agency agreement. This includes live-streaming, voice chat rooms, gaming, and influencer-driven user-generated content, leveraging a network of influencers and content creators.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of one- to four-family residential mortgage loans, including conforming, jumbo, and home equity loans and lines of credit, primarily secured by properties in the bank's market area. Loans are underwritten to Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac or investor guidelines and may be fixed or adjustable rate. Delivery is through in-house origination and purchases from mortgage brokers.

products.name: Commercial and Multi-Family Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of loans secured by commercial properties (office, industrial, retail) and multi-family residential properties (five or more units), with both fixed and adjustable rates. Loans are underwritten with conservative loan-to-value ratios and debt service coverage requirements, and are primarily for properties in the bank's market area.

products.name: Construction Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to finance the construction of residential, commercial, and multi-family properties, as well as land acquisition. These loans are typically interest-only during construction and convert to permanent financing upon completion. Delivery is through direct relationships with local developers and borrowers.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Provision of commercial loans and adjustable-rate lines of credit to small and medium-sized businesses, secured by business assets such as accounts receivable, inventory, or equipment. Includes both revolving lines and term loans, with underwriting focused on cash flow and collateral.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offering of consumer loans, primarily consumer lines of credit, to individuals in the bank's market area. Underwriting is based on creditworthiness and ability to repay. This is a minor portion of the loan portfolio.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provision of a variety of deposit accounts to individuals, businesses, and municipalities, including demand accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit. Accounts are offered through branch locations and are a primary funding source for the bank.

products.name: Investment Securities Portfolio
products.description: Investment in and management of a portfolio of securities, including U.S. government and agency obligations, municipal securities, corporate bonds, and mortgage-backed securities. Investments are managed for liquidity, income, and regulatory compliance, not as a customer-facing product.

products.name: Airtime Services (Satellite and Cellular Internet & VoIP)
products.description: Subscription-based high-speed Internet and VoIP services delivered via global satellite networks (LEO, GEO), 5G/LTE cellular, and shore-based Wi-Fi, managed through proprietary network infrastructure and customer portals. Services are provided through flexible rate plans and include 24/7 support.

products.name: Connectivity as a Service (AgilePlans)
products.description: All-inclusive subscription service for commercial maritime customers bundling satellite communication hardware, installation, maintenance, airtime, VoIP, service management portal, and basic content services for a single monthly fee. Hardware is provided on a rental basis and must be returned upon service termination.

products.name: Content Services (Entertainment, News, Music)
products.description: Commercially licensed entertainment content (movies, TV, news, music) distributed to maritime customers via over-the-air satellite delivery or encrypted USB drives, managed by the KVH Media Group. Includes digital newspapers and crew-focused content, delivered through proprietary platforms and with studio-approved DRM.

products.name: Mobile Satellite Antenna Systems (TracNet, TracPhone, TracVision)
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of stabilized, parabolic mobile satellite antenna products for two-way Internet/VoIP (TracNet, TracPhone) and receive-only satellite TV (TracVision), using advanced robotics and control software for automatic satellite tracking on moving vessels. Includes hybrid terminals integrating VSAT, 5G/LTE, and Wi-Fi.

products.name: Third-Party Satellite and Cellular Hardware Resale
products.description: Resale and distribution of third-party satellite and cellular communication terminals (e.g., Starlink, Eutelsat OneWeb, Iridium Certus, Intellian, Cobham) and associated airtime, enabling customers to access KVH's network and value-added services using non-KVH hardware.

products.name: Network and Bandwidth Management Solutions (CommBox Edge)
products.description: Enterprise-grade network and bandwidth management tools for maritime customers, integrating cloud-managed interfaces, real-time data metering, WAN combination, advanced routing, security, and VPN. Delivered as onboard hardware/software and cloud/mobile applications, often bundled with connectivity services.

products.name: Value-Added Maritime IT and Cybersecurity Services
products.description: Subscription-based services including managed firewall, cloud email, crew Internet support, real-time vessel tracking, and cybersecurity, delivered via KVH’s network and often bundled with connectivity solutions. Services leverage third-party technologies and are integrated into the KVH ONE platform.
